deals.evidence: Das Gesamtvolumen der Anleihe beträgt 30 Mio. Euro, während der Emissionsphase wurden 17 Mio. Euro davon platziert.
deals.headline: Werder places EUR 17m of a 6.50% 2021/26 bond (ISIN DE000A3H3KP5)
deals.summary: SV Werder Bremen GmbH & Co KG aA offered a five-year bond of up to EUR 30m with a 6.50% coupon; EUR 17m was placed in the offer period. It was redeemed early on 30 June 2025 after the 2025/30 bond refinanced it.

deals.evidence: Für das Geld erhält die neu gegründete Gesellschaft der künftigen Partner rund 18% der Anteile an der SV Werder Bremen GmbH & Co KGaA.
deals.headline: Regional alliance of Bremen entrepreneurs pays EUR 38m for about 18% of Werder's KGaA
deals.investor: Regionales Bündnis (Frank Baumann, Arnd Brüning, Jens Christophers, Marco Fuchs, Martin Harren, Klaus Meier, Harm Ohlmeyer, Kurt Zech)
deals.summary: In a capital increase, a newly formed company of regional entrepreneurs and private individuals with long Werder ties invested EUR 38m for roughly 18% of SV Werder Bremen GmbH & Co KG aA and two supervisory-board seats; resale is restricted and Werder holds a right of first refusal.

deals.headline: Werder raises EUR 25m with a 5.75% 2025/30 bond (ISIN DE000A4DFGZ7)
deals.summary: The 2025/30 bond was upsized from a EUR 20m target to EUR 25m at a 5.75% coupon; net proceeds of about EUR 17.8m after the exchange volume and costs refinanced the 2021/26 bond and fund infrastructure, women's football and digital projects.

deals.evidence: hält als Minderheitsgesellschafter nunmehr 19,39 Prozent an der KGaA
deals.headline: Second capital increase lifts the regional alliance's Werder stake to 19.39%
deals.investor: Regionales Bündnis (joined by Klaus and Marcus Wittrock)
deals.source_name: Anleihen Finder (SV Werder Bremen press release)
deals.summary: With Klaus and Marcus Wittrock (Wittrock crane-hire group) joining, the regional alliance acquired further shares in a capital increase and now holds 19.39% of the KGaA as a minority shareholder. The amount was not disclosed.

notes: werder.de sits behind a bot checkpoint (Vercel) that blocks automated fetches, so the club's own pages are cited through their web.archive.org captures; the same 2024/25 figures are in the club's finance update (archived). 2024/25 (year to 30 June 2025): group revenue EUR 142.7m, net loss EUR 7.4m (Jahresfehlbetrag, after tax; not recorded as pretax_result), operating expenses EUR 151.7m, equity EUR 14.9m (ratio 15.8%). H1 2025/26 (to 31 Dec 2025): revenue EUR 72.0m, loss EUR 4.8m, equity EUR 10.0m; full-year 2025/26 accounts not yet published. The e.V.'s exact percentage after the two capital increases is not stated on any page read (it was the 100% owner before 2024), so its stake is left null. The 2026 capital increase amount was not disclosed. Stadium ownership is from a 2013 Weser-Kurier report; no later page was found confirming the 50/50 split is unchanged. No valuation (not in Forbes 2026 or Football Benchmark European Elite 2026). Kit supplier not confirmed on a fetchable page; main shirt sponsor from ran.de (2026/27 list). Wages are the DFL's published personnel expense for 2024/25 (group accounts, EUR 74,580k).

ownership_summary: The professional club is SV Werder Bremen GmbH & Co KG aA, controlled by the members' association Sport-Verein "Werder" von 1899 e.V. as main shareholder. Since January 2024 a regional alliance of Bremen entrepreneurs has held a minority stake: about 18% bought for EUR 38m in a capital increase, raised to 19.39% in a second capital increase announced in March 2026. Werder also funds itself through listed SME bonds (EUR 25m 5.75% 2025/30).
